title: Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025 seeks to prevent AI companies from overcharging customers and manipulating wages. It aims to establish regulations that protect consumers and workers from unfair AI-driven pricing and labor practices.

title: BRIDGE AI Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Homeland Security.
summary: The BRIDGE AI Act is a proposed set of rules aimed at guiding the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence. It focuses on building trust, ensuring fairness, and protecting users while encouraging innovation across industries.

title: Strategy for Public Health Preparedness and Response to Artificial Intelligence Threats
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
summary: This policy outlines a plan to strengthen public health systems against risks posed by artificial intelligence, such as misinformation, data manipulation, and rapid disease spread modeling. It calls for coordinated efforts among health agencies, tech firms, and international partners to monitor AI developments, develop safeguards, and maintain public trust.

title: A bill to require the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue rules relating to the use of artificial intelligence by public companies, and for other purposes.
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: This bill asks the Securities and Exchange Commission to create regulations that govern how public companies can use artificial intelligence. It also includes additional provisions related to corporate governance and investor protection.

title: Reliable Artificial Intelligence Research Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Subcommittee on Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Protection.
summary: The Reliable Artificial Intelligence Research Act of 2026 is a law that sets standards and oversight for AI research to make sure the systems built are trustworthy, safe, and aligned with society’s values. It requires researchers to follow strict testing, documentation, and ethical guidelines, and creates a regulatory body to monitor and enforce compliance.

title: To direct the Secretary of Homeland Security, acting through the Director of the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, to establish a Critical Infrastructure AI Cyber Defense Pilot Program, and for other purposes.
action: Referred to the Subcommittee on Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Protection.
summary: This policy directs the Secretary of Homeland Security, through the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, to launch a pilot program that uses AI to defend critical infrastructure from cyber threats. It also covers additional measures to enhance national cybersecurity.

title: CISA Securing AI Task Force Act
action: Referred to the Subcommittee on Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Protection.
summary: The CISA Securing AI Task Force Act creates a dedicated team inside the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to develop and oversee strategies for protecting AI systems and infrastructure. The task force will work with industry, academia, and other government agencies to identify risks, share best practices, and promote resilient AI deployments across the nation.

title: CREATE AI Act of 2025
action: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 29 - 0.
summary: The CREATE AI Act of 2025 is a proposed U.S. law that establishes comprehensive rules for the development, deployment, and use of artificial intelligence to promote safety, transparency, and accountability. It sets requirements for high‑risk AI systems, data governance, and oversight mechanisms while also encouraging innovation and protecting privacy.

title: Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025 is a law designed to stop companies from using algorithms to coordinate unfair pricing or market behavior. It sets rules for monitoring, disclosure, and penalties to ensure competitive markets.

title: Small Business Artificial Intelligence Training Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: The Small Business Artificial Intelligence Training Act of 2026 aims to equip small businesses with the skills and resources needed to adopt AI technologies effectively, boosting competitiveness and innovation. It likely outlines funding, partnerships with educational institutions, and guidance on responsible AI use tailored to the unique needs and capacities of small enterprises.

title: To amend the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to establish within the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency the National Cyber and AI Investigations Board to investigate significant cyber incidents, cyber incidents involving terrorism, and cyber incidents involving artificial intelligence, to determine root causes and develop recommendations to prevent similar incidents and address terrorism threats to the United States, including threats relating to the malicious use of information systems or artificial intelligence by covered foreign adversaries, including terrorist organizations, and for other purposes.
action: Referred to the House Committee on Homeland Security.
summary: The proposed amendment would create a National Cyber and AI Investigations Board within the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency to probe major cyber incidents—including those involving terrorism and artificial intelligence—and analyze root causes to suggest preventive measures. The board’s findings would guide policy makers, law enforcement, and the public in mitigating future cyber threats, especially those posed by foreign adversaries and terrorist organizations.

title: Artificial Intelligence Data Center Moratorium Act
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Foreign Affairs, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The law places a temporary pause on building and operating new data centers specifically for artificial intelligence, giving regulators time to assess their environmental and security impacts. It also requires existing AI data centers to report their energy use and plan upgrades to meet future sustainability standards.

title: Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026 seeks to regulate the environmental footprint of AI systems by setting standards for energy consumption and carbon emissions. It establishes guidelines for companies to assess, report, and reduce the ecological effects of AI development and deployment.

title: Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026 establishes rules for evaluating and reducing the environmental effects produced by artificial intelligence systems. It requires developers and users of AI to adopt sustainable practices to protect ecosystems and promote long‑term ecological health.

title: Artificial Intelligence Data Center Moratorium Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Data Center Moratorium Act proposes a temporary halt to the construction or operation of new AI data centers. It aims to address environmental and societal concerns by pausing expansion while reviewing regulatory frameworks.

title: American AI Security Act
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Intelligence (Permanent Select), for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The American AI Security Act is a U.S. law designed to protect national interests by setting rules for how artificial intelligence systems are developed, tested, and used. It requires companies and government agencies to follow standards for safety, transparency, and cooperation so that AI tools cannot be misused or cause harm to the country.

title: Sectoral AI Governance Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Sectoral AI Governance Act of 2026 sets rules for artificial intelligence used in key industries like healthcare, finance, and transportation. It creates industry‑specific regulators to enforce safety, transparency, and accountability standards that match each sector’s unique risks.

title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that Congress must refuse to provide any additional funds or exceptional regulatory support to companies or financial institutions facing insolvency or financial collapse due to exposures to acute stress within the artificial intelligence market and must provide support to all harmed Americans instead.
action: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The House says Congress should not give extra money or special regulatory help to companies or banks that are in trouble because of stress in the AI market. Instead, Congress must focus on helping all Americans who have been harmed.

title: VET Artificial Intelligence Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: The VET Artificial Intelligence Act regulates the use of AI tools in vocational education and training to ensure they are safe, transparent, and fair for students and educators. It sets standards for data protection, accountability, and ethical use to guard against potential risks associated with AI in learning environments.

title: Doctors Not AI Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Doctors Not AI Act of 2026 aims to keep medical care in the hands of licensed human doctors instead of relying on artificial intelligence. It establishes regulations that prevent AI from diagnosing, prescribing, or treating patients without direct supervision from a qualified physician.

title: Algorithmic Accountability Act of 2025
action: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
summary: The Algorithmic Accountability Act of 2025 seeks to regulate the use of AI by requiring companies to assess and disclose the potential impacts of automated decision systems. It mandates regular audits, transparency reports, and accountability measures to minimize bias, protect privacy, and ensure fairness in algorithmic outcomes.
